android.desc:
LocalMind is a private AI assistant that runs entirely on your phone. No account, no cloud AI, no tracking. Your chats, documents and notes never leave your device.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• The AI model runs on your phone's CPU/GPU
• Chats, documents, notes and memory are stored only on your device
• No sign-in, no ads, no analytics
• Maximum Privacy Mode blocks all network access
• Works offline once a model is downloaded

CHAT WITH AI
• Fast streaming answers, regenerate, chat history
• Ask about photos with vision models
• Long-term memory you can view, edit and clear
• AI tools: create notes and tasks, set alarms and timers, add calendar events

YOUR DOCUMENTS
• Ask questions about PDF, Word, EPUB and text files with page citations
• Summarize, explain, rewrite, translate and reply to any text
• Share text, PDFs and images from any app, or select text and tap "Ask LocalMind"

STUDY ZONE
• Flashcards, quizzes, mind maps, explain-like-I'm-5
• Lecture notes from YouTube, essay helper, math checker, study planner
• Language tutor and debate practice

VOICE & AUDIO
• Talk to your assistant hands-free
• Read replies aloud, transcription, audio studio

OPTIONAL WEB FEATURES
• Ask the Web and AI Researcher read web pages and answer with citations
• Uses your own free Serper.dev key; the AI still runs on your phone

PICK YOUR MODEL
• Qwen, Gemma, InternVL and more from Hugging Face (LiteRT community)
• The app checks your phone and recommends models that fit its memory

Requirements: 64-bit Android 8.0+, 6 GB RAM or more recommended. Models are 1–4 GB downloads (Wi-Fi recommended).

AI replies can be inaccurate. Long-press a reply to report it.
